answer: Audits are entered in raven, queued in reef, and wharf publishes the wait time. A farm of 196 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 88 identities per epoch. A farm of 4852 identities would post 1474 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
